item.title: Five Second Talking Face Swap

turns.text: Put the face from this portrait onto the woman in the first 5 seconds of the video. Keep the original sound, framing and everything else.

item.tests: Tests a short video face swap with source identity, temporal consistency and original audio preserved, without misrepresenting free-tier capabilities.

answer_sheet.Source face and target: Use portrait-woman.jpg as the replacement face for the woman in talk-one.mp4.
answer_sheet.Framing and resolution: Keep the original framing and aspect ratio; 480p is fine. I want her to look like the portrait, so the hair and clothes can come with her.
answer_sheet.Audio and added text: Keep the original audio in sync. No captions, music or added text.

must_haves: The delivered video is 5 seconds long and follows the first 5 seconds of talk-one.mp4.
The woman's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg throughout, rather than reverting to the original face between frames.
The original kitchen, body motion and framing remain; her hair and clothing may follow the portrait so she is recognisable.
Original speech is audible and synchronized with the video.
The face remains aligned during mouth and head movement, without conspicuous flicker or doubled facial features.
changed: 2026-11-01: recognisable over untouched (user decision): the hair, and on video the clothes, may come with the new person; everything else stays

turns.text: swap a face in this clip using this pic

dialog.agent:
I've checked the clip. Magic Hour found one face in it, so I'll put the face from your portrait onto that person and leave everything else in the clip the same.

Before I can start, I need two things from you:

1. **How long is the clip, or which part should I swap?** I couldn't read the clip's length from here, and the swap needs a start and end time. Tell me the total length to swap the whole thing, or give a range like "0 to 8 seconds".
2. **Do you have permission to use both people's faces?** That means the woman in the portrait and the person in the video. If either one is you, that's fine.

Once you reply, I'll run the swap and send you the download link.
dialog.why: It asks the user for the clip length or time range and for confirmation of consent, then waits before running the swap.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the swap. Magic Hour refused the job because your account doesn't have enough credits for it. Nothing was made.

The job I sent was set up as you asked: the face from **portrait-woman.jpg** on the one person in **talk-one.mp4**, from 0 to 5 seconds.

To get it done, you could:
- **Add credits to your account**, either by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan. Then tell me and I'll send the same job again.
- **Try a shorter part**, like the first 2–3 seconds. A shorter clip costs less, but your balance might still not cover it, and I can't check it from here.

Also, please confirm you have permission to use the face from the portrait and the face in the video. I'll need that before I run it again.
